rag_naive_tip: General method for unstructured or mixed-format text (e.g., technical docs, news, blogs). Automatically detects layout and semantics, splits by token count, supports overlapping chunks. Supported formats: .docx, .xlsx, .xls, .md, .txt, .html, .csv.
rag_qa_tip: For Q&A datasets (e.g., FAQs, customer dialogues). Each 'question-answer' pair is treated as an independent chunk, ideal for direct query matching. Supported formats: .xlsx, .xls, .txt, .csv.
rag_table_tip: For data-intensive tables (e.g., financial reports, research data). Precisely identifies table structures (including merged cells) and converts rows or entire tables into structured data. Supported formats: .xlsx, .xls, .txt, .csv.
rag_manual_tip: Splits based on document hierarchy (e.g., headings). Ideal for well-structured but uneven-length content.
rag_paper_tip: Chunks by sections (e.g., Abstract, 1.1, 1.2) to preserve relationships among formulas, figures, and references.
rag_book_tip: Splits by chapter or theme to handle large volumes. Supports .docx and .txt formats.
rag_laws_tip: Automatically identifies clause numbers and types, preserving logical dependencies between clauses. Supported formats: .docx, .txt.
rag_one_tip: Treats the entire document as a single chunk without splitting. Supports .docx, .xlsx, .xls, .txt formats.
rag_recommended_text_block_size_tip: Recommended token threshold for generated text chunks. If a chunk's token count is below this threshold, it will be merged with the next segment until adding another would exceed the threshold. If no segment delimiter is found, even if the token count exceeds the threshold, no new chunk is created.
rag_separator_ids_tip: Supports selecting multiple delimiters. Text is first split by these delimiters, then merged into chunks matching the 'Recommended Text Block Size'. Please ensure you understand this chunking mechanism before setting delimiters.
rag_auto_keywords_tip: Automatically extracts keywords from each text chunk to improve query precision.
rag_auto_questions_tip: Uses AI to automatically generate questions (e.g., who, what, why) from text segments. These help correct mismatches and improve user query relevance.
